Ooredoo تُتوج الفائزين في الطبعة الثالثة: Ooredoo rewards the winners of the 3rd edition of "Etoile Montante"
انطلاقاً من التزامها الدائم باكتشاف وتثم: Driven by its constant commitment to discovering and valuing the talents of tomorrow, Ooredoo Algeria organized on the evening of Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at the Faculty of Information and Communication Sciences (University of Algiers 3), in the "Nelson Mandela" amphitheater, the award ceremony for the winners of the 3rd edition of the "Etoile Montante" competition.
تميز هذا الحفل بحضور وزير الاتصال السيد: This ceremony was marked by the presence of the Minister of Communication, Mr. Mohamed Bouslimani, official figures, and guest of honor, reflecting the support given to student innovation. The event was also attended by an elite group of media professionals, university professors, prominent figures in Algerian journalism, as well as leading experts in the fields of technology and digital transformation, in addition to the General Manager of Ooredoo Algeria, Mr. Rony Tomeh, accompanied by company executives.
باعتبارها منصة تقييم حقيقية للجيل الصاعد: As a true evaluation platform for the rising generation, the 3rd edition of this competition proposed a theme to students in line with the profound transformations undergoing the media sector, under the title: "Artificial Intelligence and the Future of Media in Algeria: Challenges and Prospects". This choice reflects Ooredoo's desire to encourage young students to adopt a critical and forward-looking perspective on the technological changes that are shaping today the professions of media and communication.
أثارت هذه الطبعة حماساً كبيراً وإقبالاً: This edition generated great enthusiasm and wide participation in student circles, recording the participation of 66 students representing the National Higher School of Journalism and Information Sciences as well as various institutes and faculties of information and communication sciences across the country. At the end of a competition marked by the quality and diversity of the works submitted, 11 winners were awarded across four main categories: written reports, digital reports, radio reports, and audiovisual reports.

برئاسة البروفيسور عبد السلام بن زاوي، ال: Chaired by Professor Abdelslam Benzaoui, former Director of the National Higher School of Journalism and Information Sciences, the competition's jury examined the various works submitted according to a rigorous evaluation, based primarily on relevance, quality of treatment, originality, and analytical capability. The deliberations took place in an atmosphere of complete transparency and objectivity, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation of the works submitted by the candidates.

وفي كلمة ألقاها خلال هذا الحفل، صرح السي: In a speech delivered during this ceremony, Mr. Rony Tomeh, General Manager of "Ooredoo Algeria", stated: "We are very proud today to celebrate the excellence of the young students who participated in this 3rd edition of 'Etoile Montante'. This competition, which gains momentum and importance year after year, is the best proof of the true reservoir of excellence and creativity that Algerian universities abound in. Today we celebrate these young talents who shone with the quality of their work, proving that the future of Algerian journalism is in safe hands. I would like to express my deep gratitude to the jury members for their high professionalism, and I extend my warmest congratulations to all the winners, wishing them a career crowned with success."
اعترافًا بجهودهم ولغرض مرافقتهم في مواصل: In recognition of their efforts and to support them in continuing their academic and professional path, the winners received trophies along with technological equipment, including laptops and tablets, designed to support them in their research work and future projects.
وعقب هذه المراسم، اغتنم السيد وزير الاتص: Following this ceremony, the Minister of Communication took the opportunity to extend his warmest congratulations and best wishes to the entire Algerian media and journalistic family, on the occasion of the National Press Day, celebrated on October 22 of each year.
ووفاءً لروحها المبتكرة، تجدد \"Ooredoo\": True to its innovative spirit, "Ooredoo" reaffirms, through the "Etoile Montante" competition, its constant quest to value Algerian youth, stimulate their passion for journalism, and pave the way for them towards excellence and success.
